content.text:
The chat UI now re-renders on every streamed chunk instead of in batches. The fix is one line in `src/client/Chat.jsx:8`:

```js
const { messages, sendMessage, status } = useAgentChat({ agent, throttle: false });
```

**Why:** since `agents` 0.22, `useAgentChat` groups streamed updates and applies them every 50ms by default. This project has 0.27.0 installed, so `TokenMeter` was only seeing one re-render per 50ms batch. That capped the meter at about 20 tokens/s and made it read low. I checked the installed `node_modules/agents/dist/chat/react.js`: `throttle: false` is what turns the batching off. I added a short comment so nobody removes the option later.

I haven't run the app to watch the meter live.
